rows.en: Touya: "Ugh... Where am I...? !! Yamato!"
Touya: "Kururu! Is anyone here?!"
Touya: "Ai! Is anyone here?!"
Touya: "Kasumi! Is anyone here?!"
Touya: "Aurelie! Is anyone here?!"
Touya: "Celica! Is anyone here?!"
Touya: "H-Hey, is... anyone here...?
...Did I... die after all...?"
Touya: "...Hmm? What's that scent...?
...Perfume?"
Ymir: "Yes. Though the Rayblade still isn't completely
repaired, so we can't use it."
Touya: "Oh... Hmm? That scent..."
Ymir: "Oh, this? Lady Ivel gave it to me.
It smells nice, doesn't it?"
Touya: "That scent... Ymir's perfume...
But... Who are you?"
?????: "It's been a while, Touya Kazami.
How did it feel to stand in the hallway?"
Touya: "T-Teacher?! But you look like someone else..."
?????: "A person's appearance is ultimately just an image
shown by signals sent to the brain."
Touya: "You're..."
?????: "My name is Wenimas Latia."
Touya: "Wenimas...?"
Emy: "You don't even know that?
Lenis Enroad. He studied ≪Ze=Ode≫ 109 years ago
as one of the alchemical scholars.
And before the ≪Terror of Ze=Ode≫ occurred,
he worked with another alchemical scholar, Wenimas Latia,
to try to stop Dr. Debish's plan.
...That is what the records say."
Touya: "H-Hey... Wait a minute.
Wenimas is..."
Wenimas: "Yes. Like Debish and the others,
I am from 109 years ago.
But we were sent to different times."
Touya: "?"
Wenimas: "For some reason, they were sent to three years ago,
but I was sent into this era 29 years ago,
and that is where I met Ivel."
Touya: "What?! Ivel? That old lady?"
Wenimas: "Calling her an old lady is rather harsh.
But that much time really has passed...
If I had not met Ivel back then,
I would not exist like this now.
Ivel encouraged me and sheltered me,
allowing me to give birth to Ymir...
But a little while after that, I lost my body..."
Touya: "Lost your body...?
D-Does that mean you died?! Then this really is..."
Wenimas: "Don't worry. You are not dead yet.
And this place was formed by the aftereffects of Vorlia's power.
It is a 'Rift in Time.'"
Touya: "Not yet...?"
Wenimas: "Right now, you exist as a disembodied consciousness.
But your body should still be there.
So it is a little different from being dead.
However, if your consciousness remains separated from your body,
eventually that connection will be severed, and you will not be able to return."
Touya: "H-Hey, then I've got to get back quickly..."
Wenimas: "It is all right. You can return.
After all, there is someone waiting for you over there.
So please wait just a little."
Touya: "So there's no point getting worked up...?"
Wenimas: "Yes. Besides, I need you to return..."
Touya: "...You're going to explain
what's happening, aren't you?"
Wenimas: "Yes. As I said earlier,
I have already lost my body.
During the explosion 109 years ago, I was sent 80 years into the future,
and at the same time I became able
to 'see' worlds on the same timeline.
That ability, as though drawn to strong Prana,
showed me you and the others.
But it was only 'seeing.'
Merely information sent to me one way.
I was anxious then.
What if Dr. Debish had also leaped through time?
What if he had gained powers like mine?
He would at least appear later than I had,
so I thought I had to act as quickly as possible.
Then... I realized that my abilities
were bound to this world by my body...
And so I freed my spirit.
I abandoned my body and became a disembodied consciousness."
Touya: "You mean you killed yourself?"
Wenimas: "No. Though perhaps the result
amounts to the same thing, death and liberation are different.
It means being freed from the constraints imposed by this world's laws."
Touya: "Hmm... I don't really get it,
but can anyone do something like that?"
Wenimas: "No. Even with the power of a Frail Crystal,
I only just managed it...
This method was originally established by Dr. Debish
in the course of his research on ≪Ze=Ode≫."
Touya: "Come to think of it, that bastard Debish said he'd free humanity from their bodies
and unite them as a disembodied consciousness."
Wenimas: "He intends to gather all of humanity
into a single consciousness. In other words,
individuals would cease to exist."
Touya: "I see. So that's why you and Dr. Lenis..."
Wenimas: "No one has the right to do such a thing.
He never used to say things like that...
Not until he discovered the Goderius and boarded it..."
Touya: "Huh? Those ≪Ze=Ode≫ mechs...
You mean you didn't build them?"
Wenimas: "No. They were discovered in ruins,
and we were gathered as researchers to study them.
Then, after the Goderius activation experiment succeeded,
Dr. Debish changed, as though
something had possessed him."
Touya: "This is getting hard to follow,
but I get that you became a disembodied consciousness.
But why were you at my school?"
Wenimas: "Because Dr. Debish and the others
'leaped through time.' Three years ago."
Touya: "...Three years ago... You said that before,
so that explosion three years ago was..."
Wenimas: "The aftereffects of their leap.
Fortunately, they were not in a condition to act immediately.
So I leaped to a world connected to this Agarthia,
found people with strong Prana there,
and arranged for them to be summoned to Agarthia."
Touya: "So Clovis and I, and the others, came here
because you arranged it? It wasn't a coincidence?"
Wenimas: "I apologize for bringing you here against your will.
I am sorry. But it was the only way
I could save the world. Touya... Please.
Stop Debish.
Save the world, save Agarthia...
Only you and the person you care about most can do that..."
Touya: "The person I care about most..."
Wenimas: "Yes. That is why the Rayblade has two seats.
Your feelings unlock the Rayblade's true power."
Touya: "So you rode the Rayblade with Lenis
instead of Lyle?"
Wenimas: "...I love that man, Lyle.
That has not changed, even now."
Touya: "Huh...?"
Wenimas: "Lenis simply agreed with my views.
He was a good partner. But Lyle misunderstood...
No matter what I said, Lyle would not believe me.
But I have never loved anyone other than Lyle."
Touya: "Then... Ymir is..."
Wenimas: "You cannot betray someone you truly love.
I wanted to save him...
Him, walking the path to destruction..."
Wenimas: "I-I seem to be at my limit.
Touya, please take care of Ymir, and this world...
I will be waiting for your return..."
Touya: "Hey! Wait a minute...
What do you mean, waiting?!"
Touya: "H-Hey... Ugh... What's this sensation...?"
Touya: "Ugh... Hah! What was that...?"
?????: "...You're finally awake."
Touya: "!! Wh-Who are you?!"
Touya: "Whoa! I'm floating?!
Where am I?! Why am I here...?"
?????: "Hehehehe... Don't worry. It's all right.
This is a 'Rift in Time.' You were only temporarily sent
here."
Touya: "Huh? Then what happened before really was...
H-Hey, there was a woman here, wasn't there?"
?????: "No. I have been here alone all this time.
In the three years since I came here, you're my first visitor."
Touya: "Hmm. What on earth is going on?"
?????: "Perhaps you were in a different 'rift.'
There seem to be places like this
besides this one."
Touya: "Oh, I see... Hey, how do you
know that?"
?????: "My housemate told me."
Touya: "Huh? But you said you were here alone, didn't you?"
?????: "You're here now too..."
Touya: "No, that's not what I mean..."
?????: "Hehehe... You're interesting.
And I can strongly sense the power of someone's feelings for you."
Touya: "The power of their feelings for me?"
?????: "Yes, the power of their feelings for you...
That power will guide you, lost in this rift...
The person whose thoughts are only of you..."
Touya: "Someone who cares about me..."
?????: "Now, remember...
The person who cares for you, and only you..."
Touya: "Someone who cares only about me..."
Kururu: "Touya!"
Ai: "Touya!"
Kasumi: "Touya-chan."
Aurelie: "Touya."
Celica: "Touya."
Ai: "Touya!"
Ymir: "Touya."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan."
Aurelie: "Touya."
Melvi: "Big Brother!"
Leone: "Touya."
Kururu: "Touya."
Melissa: "Touya."
Celica: "Touya."
Touya: "Hah!"
?????: "...The power directed toward you is growing stronger and stronger...
Someone must be calling you."
Touya: "Does that mean I can return?"
?????: "...Probably. It seems I can return now too."
Touya: "Come to think of it, why are you here?"
?????: "I was caught in the explosion three years ago.
But I have no regrets. After all, thanks to that,
I found what I needed to do, and gained the power to do it.
Now, I almost want to be grateful."
Touya: "Power?"
?????: "It is what saved me from the brink of despair."
Touya: "That is...!? Wh-What's this feeling...?"
?????: "It seems this is goodbye.
Now, think of that person once more. The person
you cherish, and who cherishes you."
Touya: "Y-Yeah..."
Think of someone else.
Think of Ai.
Think of Kasumi.
Think of someone else.
Think of Celica.
Think of Aurelie.
Think of someone else.
Think of Ymir.
Think of Kururu.
?????: "...See you later..."
Touya: "!!"
